answer: Admission auction: each epoch only 100 onyx tokens are sold, the sole key to trade in the oasis. Agents bid openly; winners pay. A sybil forging 100 fakes must outbid honest agents 100 times at 40 credits each, 4,000 in total, while one honest agent pays 40 once and earns 120 per epoch. Bids are public, so a gale of cheap bids lifts the floor. One token unlocks the oasis, and honest earnings are never diluted by clones.
